officialName: Trotec Speedy 400 CO2 Laser Engraving System
description: The Trotec Speedy 400 is a CO2 laser engraver and cutter with an enclosed working area of 1016 x 610 mm. In a makerspace, students use it to cut and engrave wood, acrylic, paper, leather and fabric for prototypes, enclosures, signs and models. It can also engrave glass, stone and anodized aluminum.

specs.label: Max. workpiece height
specs.value: 305 mm (12 in) with 1.5 in or 2.0 in lens

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: +/- 0.015 mm (0.0006 in) over the whole working area

specs.label: Max. material load
specs.value: Static up to 100 kg (220 lbs); dynamic up to 30 kg (66 lbs)

useRestrictions: Only trained and authorised users may run it, never leave it unattended while it is lasing, and only cut or engrave materials on the lab's approved list.
